candidates.desc: A young runner in a blue race shirt pants at the finish line, gets a gold medal hung around his neck, and proudly presses both hands to his chest where the medal rests.

A runner on the Great Wall of China stretches one leg high up on the stone parapet, then sprints up the steep stairs with close-ups of her legs and feet, finishing with her hands on her knees, breathing hard and smiling.

Two dachshunds lie flat on their backs on a sunny concrete patio with their bellies turned up to the sun and their legs flopped out. A hand comes into the shot holding a white kitchen turner and hovers it over the nearest dog's belly, as if about to flip it like something cooking. The dogs do not move; a third dachshund in a green collar walks up to the spatula at the end.

A young woman with her hair in a messy bun sits curled on a sofa under a checked blanket, crying. Her eyes and the skin around her nose are red and swollen. She lifts a white tissue to her face, covers her nose with both hands and blows it, then lowers the tissue and goes on crying with the blanket clutched to her chest.

Three people work out together on a path in a green park. An older woman in a bright red tracksuit stands in the middle between a young woman in a mint jacket and a young man in a grey hoodie. All three stretch both arms straight up over their heads with their palms open, then jog on the spot swinging their arms bent at the elbow, then swing both arms wide out to the sides at shoulder height. They keep smiling at the camera while other walkers and a dog pass under the fresh green trees behind them.

An extreme close up fills the screen with one brown eye: the white, the ring of brown around the black centre, the reflections of the ceiling lights and the long lashes above and below. A thumb comes in and gently pulls the upper lid open wider. An optician holds a small black torch beside the eye and shines it in, and the brown ring lights up amber while the black centre shrinks. The shot pulls back to show a young woman smiling in an optician's shop with walls of spectacle frames behind her, and finally the optician holds up a big cut through model of an eyeball beside her while she points at it and talks.

A young woman in a neon yellow vest stands on an outdoor basketball court breathing hard with her mouth open after playing. She presses her flat hand onto her chest over her heart and looks down, still panting. A man in a green shirt comes up beside her, puts his hand on her shoulder and stares wide-eyed at the camera; the two of them then lean over the smartwatch on her wrist and both react in shock at the number on it while other players carry on with the ball behind them.

Five friends are on a sunny rooftop terrace with a city skyline behind them. Two of them laugh with an arm laid across the other's back, hand resting where the neck meets the arm. The group lines up side by side, each one's arm hooked over the next one's upper body, and walks forward together; a low shot catches their trainers on the tiles. They pull into a tight circle with hands on each other's backs, then line up again and jump into the air with their arms flung up.

A first-person clip in the tropics: an outstretched arm and open hand with beaded bracelets fills the foreground, leading the camera along a path through misty green rice terraces while a smiling long-haired man holds on at the other end. He then sits on the steps of a carved stone temple beside a monkey, and finally rides a big rope swing out over a jungle valley of palms and terraces, feet bare against the sky.

On a green football pitch a player in a white kit dribbles the ball, then suddenly pulls up, grimaces and doubles over. He drops onto the grass and grips his leg just above the boot, his face twisted in pain. Two opponents in blue crouch down, take him under the arms and lift him back onto his feet, and he ends up sitting on a wooden bench at the side of the pitch, still holding the same spot above his foot.

A young man in a white T-shirt and denim shorts sits barefoot on a clinic examination couch while a doctor in a white coat stands beside him holding a reflex hammer. He stands up, bends his legs and drops into a deep squat facing the camera so his bare knees are in the middle of the frame, then sits back on the couch, puts a hand on his knee and laughs with the doctor.

A woman in a lilac blouse sits at an office desk in front of a computer monitor, tips her head to one side and rubs the back of her neck with her hand, wincing. She rolls her head and talks to the camera. The shot cuts to a close-up of her chest and shoulders as she loops a thick mustard scarf around her neck and knots it. Then the scene cuts outdoors: she stands at a green fence at a wildlife park in the same blouse and scarf, and a giraffe lowers its very long neck down over her head from above. She turns to the camera with her mouth wide open in astonishment, hand at her chin.

A curly-haired young man stands in a school canteen queue with both hands flat on his middle, wincing and talking as the line shuffles past trays of food. He then sits at a table and forks up a huge mouthful of spaghetti in tomato sauce, chews with his eyes shut, and finally leans back and pats his middle with both hands, satisfied.

A close shot of hot beach sand shows a pair of bare feet with the toes spread wide, and a white shell lying in the sand right in front of them. A young woman in a tie-dye T-shirt, denim shorts and a visor steps forward, treads straight onto the shell and jerks her foot up with a pained laugh. She hops on one leg, grabs the sore foot and shakes it out, then bounds away across the sand and jumps onto a striped beach towel.

A young woman with freckles smiles into the camera and pulls her lower lip down with one finger to show her front teeth close up. The film cuts to a dental surgery where she sits in the chair in a mint jumper while a dentist holds a small round mirror up to her open mouth. Then she is outside under a tree, biting into a big red apple, and finally she holds up the bitten apple and grins straight at the camera.

In a sunny city park a young woman with a blonde ponytail, a white T-shirt and light blue jeans holding an ice-cream cone looks back over her shoulder with her mouth wide open. The seat of her jeans is covered in green stripes of wet paint, and she puts one hand on her bottom. Beside her a young man in a denim jacket bends over laughing and points at the freshly painted green bench. A cardboard sign reading WET PAINT and a paint tin lie on the ground, with pigeons, joggers and a pond behind.
